column5: The assertion was renamed, not dropped. It pinned that a targeted requirement edit leaves the rest of the file alone, and it did so by checking a Change Log row. When change logs were removed from every artifact, that row ceased to exist, so the same assertion now pins an ordinary body line instead. Same suite, same purpose, same one assertion -- only the anchor it reads moved.
